title: Stop Saying "Very Dark"! 3 Better English Words #shorts
description:
Stop saying "very dark". Use one of these words instead:
• Gloomy: The garden is gloomy
• Inky: The sky turns inky black
• Pitch-black: Inside the pitch-black shed

Comment your own word for "very dark"!
